description: Shows every Codex session the current roadmap slice and item (scripts/cycle.ts), and runs the done gate (scripts/done-gate.ts): before a command or patch it notes the checkout being worked in, and when a turn ends it judges the change. Codex runs each hook only after it is trusted in /hooks.

hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/done-gate.ts"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo '{"systemMessage":"Done gate ⚠ NOT running in this checkout (scripts/done-gate.ts is missing): nothing done here is checked"}'; exit 0; }; exec "$(command -v bun || echo "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun")" "$f" hook codex
